requirements.request: Exact tagged operation ID and contract digest only; reject unknown/extra fields before dispatch
requirements.dispatcher: Read-only allowlist binds operation ID to a single installed worker artifact + exact fixed transport
requirements.executor: Immutable entrypoint and dependency closure; no generic interpreter/psql/shell/identifier/SQL API, no writable import/loader path; no second credential channel
requirements.credential: One operation and closed epoch only; no broker custody, inherited descriptor, environment disclosure or steady-state superuser connection
requirements.observer: Separate anchored principal and read entitlement; worker cannot forge outcome/audit/extinction evidence
requirements.revocation: Destroy capability/credential/session/process/descendants before reseal; old tuple never revived
